title: atp2osm configuration
description: Every setting that is not a secret. The file is named by ATP2OSM_CONFIG, which has no default: an instance that provides none refuses to start rather than quietly serving France. Secrets stay in the environment (OSM_DB_PASSWORD, OSM_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, OSM_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET, SECRET_KEY), and so does GIT_COMMIT, which the build computes.

country.description: What differs from one country to the next. Two instances serving the same country share this section.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, lowercase. Matched against addr:country in the ATP data, and read as a spider suffix (aldi_de) to tell foreign spiders apart.

locales.description: Interface languages, the first one being the default and the fallback. A country may have several (Switzerland has four); the language selector only appears when there is more than one. Each needs a catalog in website/translations/. The OSM changeset comment follows the contributor's language, so every entry here must be a language the local mapping community reads.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the dates are displayed in, and the one the daily refresh timer runs on.

geofabrik.description: Geofabrik extract paths, without the -latest.osm.pbf suffix (europe/france, australia-oceania/new-caledonia). One entry per extract to download; overseas territories are separate extracts and sometimes sit under another continent.

admin_level.description: Finest OSM admin_level a POI is attached to — the unit of a batch, of a changeset and of the cooldown. The attachment walks down from here to 2 (the country), so a territory with no polygon at this level still lands somewhere: 6 gives French départements, and Martinique falls back to 4 on its own.

admin_level_max.description: Deepest level imported from the PBF. Must be at least admin_level; take it franker rather than tighter, since its only job is to leave room to lower admin_level later without reimporting 20 GB. Level 8 adds about 35 000 polygons in France, the order of magnitude of its communes.

match_radius_m.description: How far an ATP POI may sit from an OSM object and still match it. 500 m is calibrated on European urban density; worth rediscussing where POIs sit further apart.

nsi_locations.description: Location codes whose name-suggestion-index brands apply here: the country code, its dependent territories, and the codes that contain it (150 Europe, eu, 001 world). An NSI item is kept when its locationSet includes one of these.

nsi_writable_tags.description: Tags NSI is allowed to write. NOT copied from another country: the list is produced by measuring, tag by tag, how often NSI agrees with the OSM objects of this country — run scripts/calibrate_nsi_tags.py, which writes this key and nsi_calibration together. A tag wrongly listed here raises no error, it just mistags thousands of objects. Default: the one tag whose correctness does not depend on the language.

nsi_calibration.description: The measurement that justifies nsi_writable_tags, written by scripts/calibrate_nsi_tags.py — never by hand. A tag listed as writable but absent from `agreement` is warned about at startup.

nsi_version.description: NSI release the measurement was taken on.

agreement.description: Tag → share of objects where NSI agrees with what OSM already carries, between 0 and 1.

app.description: What differs from one deployment to the next. Two instances serving the same country differ here.

env.description: PRODUCTION refuses to start without GIT_COMMIT and caches the assets for a year; DEVELOPMENT revalidates them on every request.

base_url.description: Public URL of the instance, without a trailing slash. Used to build the OAuth callback.

osm_api_host.description: Base URL of the OSM API the changesets go to. The sandbox (master.apis.dev.openstreetmap.org) for development, the real one for production — they hold different accounts and different OAuth applications.

source_repo_url.description: Repository the sidebar links to. A fork serving its own instance points at itself; left out or left empty, it points at the upstream project.

translations_dir.description: Directory of extra gettext catalogs, merged over the ones the image ships and winning on the strings they both hold. This is how a deployment serves a language the product does not ship, or changes a wording, without a fork: put <lang>/LC_MESSAGES/messages.mo under it, compiled from the msgids of the revision you run. Left out, only the shipped catalogs are read.

refresh_schedule.description: When the daily ATP + OSM refresh runs, in systemd OnCalendar syntax, read in the country's timezone. Pick an hour when the machine is idle: the refresh downloads and imports the whole country.

db.description: PostGIS connection. The password is a secret and comes from OSM_DB_PASSWORD.

pipeline.description: How hard the daily refresh is allowed to push the host.

workers.description: Parallel workers for the ATP conversion. Defaults to half the CPUs.

min_free_gb.description: Free disk space below which the osm2pgsql import refuses to start, rather than filling the disk and leaving a half-imported database.
